title: Reciprocal Associations Between Positive Emotions and Motivation in Daily Life: Network Analyses in Anhedonic Individuals and Healthy Controls
sample_size: 66 participants in anhedonia group, 68 participants in control group
estimation_packages: DSEM in Mplus Version 8, qgraph Version 1.4.3 in R
limitations: - Did not include contextual features in models; - Relatively large timeframe between assessments (6 hr) may have missed important fluctuations; - Majority of sample was female, limiting generalizability; - Findings are specific to individuals with anhedonia, not generalizable to psychiatric disorders.
notes: The paper was preregistered in the Dutch Clinical Trial Register (NTR5498). Code and data availability were not explicitly stated in the paper, so they are marked as 'check'.
